summary: Shows testing a WinRM HTTPS listener with openssl s_client, noting it uses the system trust store which may differ from Ansible's.
questions: How do I view the certificate my WinRM HTTPS listener presents?
Why does openssl trust my WinRM cert but Ansible doesn't?

answer_card.title: Checking the WinRM HTTPS certificate with openssl
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
echo '' | openssl s_client -connect server:5986
```

`openssl s_client` validates against the **system** trust store, which may not match the trust store Ansible uses (see the WinRM certificate validation section).
